description: Adds the AWS SDK for PHP so Tiger can store media in Amazon S3 — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Amazon S3 in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the Google Cloud and Azure SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; MIT license; release 3.393.4 present; module layout conforms.
